# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HOW TO USE
#   1. Copy this folder for a new lecture; rename this file (e.g. week03.qmd).
#   2. Edit the title / subtitle / author below, then edit the slides.
#   3. From this folder in Terminal:   quarto preview week03.qmd
#      The browser opens and refreshes every time you save.
#   A new slide = a level-2 heading (##). The heading becomes the slide title.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
title: "Lecture Title"
subtitle: "PHY199-RAP · Energy in the 21st Century"
author: "Dr. Salvatore Rappoccio"
format:
  # PowerPoint output (source of truth). Path assumes a Lectures/LectureNN/ location.
  pptx:
    reference-doc: ../../template/UB-template.pptx
    slide-level: 2
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, ub.scss]
    slide-number: true
    center: false
    progress: false
    math: katex
    transition: slide
    embed-resources: true
---

## First point

- One idea per slide; keep bullets short
- **Bold** the key term, *italics* for emphasis
- The talk carries the detail — the slide is the anchor

::: notes
Speaker notes live here. They stay off the slide and show in presenter view
(press `S` while presenting).
:::

## A formula

Inline math like $E = mc^2$, or a display equation:

$$
\text{LCOE} = \frac{\text{lifetime costs}}{\text{lifetime energy produced}}
$$

| Quantity | Value |

Cite a source for any figures you present.

## Takeaway

The one thing you want them to remember.
